subject: terrapup
prompt: Use case: original stylized creature concept reference for Tetherbound's authorized F36 creature refinement. Image 1 is the established Terrapup identity reference, not an edit target. Generate ONE full-body three-quarter studio view of exactly this same Terrapup in a balanced neutral standing quadruped pose suitable for a skeletal rig. Preserve its rounded brown puppy face, cream central forehead stripe and eyebrows, cream muzzle and chest, large teal-blue eyes, small upright rounded ears, broad nose, chunky paws with natural gold-brown claws, broad moss-green and gray stone shell/back plates, short stony tail. Preserve the installed character's proportions and appealing chunky silhouette; no new species or evolution. All four legs and paws should be separately visible, with modest natural spacing and clear joints, the belly separated from the ground, forelegs separate from torso and hindlegs; mouth closed, no crouch or seated pose. Face and eye area unobstructed. Stylized tactile fur masses and designed readable stone/cream/brown/moss colour blocks, moderate surface detail rather than hair noise. Plain neutral light grey background, even soft studio lighting, whole body and tail inside frame, all paws grounded, no person, ruler, text, props, clothing, mechanical armour, floating rocks, haze, sparks or Team Tether red. Produce a coherent riggable natural body; no fused limbs or exaggerated body redesign. The resulting reference is for an already larger-than-trainer creature; no shrinking design.

inspection.identity: Brown puppy face, cream forehead/muzzle/chest, teal eyes, rounded upright ears, mossy stone back/paw accents and stony short tail preserved
inspection.riggability: Neutral standing body, four distinct grounded paws; far hind leg partly occluded by torso
inspection.disposition: Eligible for one attended guarded Smart Topology textured candidate in authorized F36 priority batch; inspect before integration; no shipping flag flip
inspection.limits: One studio view does not prove reverse anatomy, topology, scale, rig/pose contact or gameplay appeal

license_workflow: Existing owner-held Meshy license; guarded attended RD-26 current-roster priority refinement; no purchase

multiview_followup.reason: Code-blind standing comparison named a head turned sideways and blotchy patches. The later preserved single-image Meshy output washed the cream/brown pattern and turned the face away in the matched Medium gameplay image. This is a distinct existing-turnaround multiview submission, not a repeat of its single-image Smart Topology task.
multiview_followup.inspection: Views agree on centered teal-eyed brown-and-cream puppy face, gray stone mantle, four sturdy paws and short stone tail; back view has one stray crop fragment outside the silhouette. No image proves generated topology or game appeal.
multiview_followup.source_scale_inspection: One GLB mesh with an identity node transform; fitting the raw height to installed 3.85 m grows it, never shrinks it. Actual engine fit, floor contact and 1.80 m trainer comparison remain unproved under the native pause.
multiview_followup.thumbnail_inspection: Remote front thumbnail shows head aligned with torso, two readable teal eyes, centered cream blaze, broad digging forepaws and shoulder stone plates. Reverse mantle, topology, skinning, finish and in-game readability are unproved.
multiview_followup.limits: No native import, game integration, pose/carry proof or acceptance. Remote thumbnail and CPU source bounds are insufficient to enable the asset.
